resources.string: Point the camera at the strip and keep it inside the box. Tap the image to move the box. A dark room works best. Hold the phone still while the strip flashes red and blue.
Stop music sync first. It also drives the strips.
fff3 uses the camera to see when the strip changes colour. Images stay on your phone and are never saved.
Camera access is off. You can allow it in the app settings.
This phone has no back camera.
This camera does not tell when each image was taken, so the delay cannot be measured.
The camera is not available. Another app may be using it.
The strip did not answer. Check that it is on and in range.
The camera did not see the strip change colour. Put the strip inside the box and try again.
Too few clear flashes. Hold the phone still, make the room darker and try again.
Lights measured with the camera: %1$d ms.
